rationale: The translation exactly reproduces the three-by-three block construction, its two-sided inverse, and the ordered product A*B in the top-right block. It also correctly keeps this exact branch free of norms, rounding, conditioning, and error tolerances. However, the selected extraction sentence is embedded in an exact complexity reduction: arbitrary eta > 0, an exact inversion routine measured in O(n^(omega+eta)) arithmetic operations, application to the 3n-by-3n construction, and an exact multiplication algorithm in the same asymptotic class. None of that algorithmic or asymptotic content is encoded. The translation therefore represents the algebraic display but is weaker than the complete display-plus-extraction result. Adjudication is requested because the paper leaves the scalar domain unstated while the translation fixes real matrices.
